_about: The open clone suites the harness runs (plan test set 2). Pinned commits; build.py fetches each into suites/_src/<name>/repo, copies the server part into suites/_build/<name>, strips vendor branding, applies our small patches and builds one container per suite. Licences read from the repos on 2026-11-03.

ocw.title: Open CaptchaWorld (MBZUAI et al., NeurIPS 2025 D&B)
ocw.licence: MIT (README statement only; the repo has no LICENSE file, checked 2026-11-03)
ocw.licence_ok: local evaluation only, nothing redistributed; the MIT statement in the README is the grant

halligan.title: Halligan benchmark (USENIX Security 2025)
halligan.licence_ok: yes; challenge images are replicas of deployed vendor challenges, so this lane stays local (never served on the hub)

excluded_types.hcaptcha: hCaptcha is never run by agents in this project (its terms forbid AI passing its challenges; CLAUDE.md)

hll.title: HLL, Humanity's Last Line of Verification (2026)
hll.licence_ok: yes; photo types use the images shipped in the repo (no Unsplash/Pexels keys set)

excluded_types.hcaptcha: real hCaptcha widget with a site key: never run by agents in this project (CLAUDE.md)
